artworks.title: Gentleman with Cane
artworks.description: The image shows a person depicted in a three-quarter view from the back. The person is in a leaning stance, with one leg forward and one arm on a cane. They have an elaborate hairstyle with a large, feathered hat. The outfit includes a fur-trimmed coat, unique sleeves, voluminous breeches, and shoes with ankle bows. The person holds a cane and there is no visible jewelry. The style is simple and sketch-like, with a plain background emphasizing the attire and pose.

artworks.title: Man with Sword
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures in profile, drawn side by side. Both figures are in a leaning pose, with their left arms positioned as if resting on a surface. The figures have exaggerated facial features, including prominent noses and lips. They wear elaborate hats with feathers and decorative elements. Their clothing consists of draped fabric, baggy pants, and a distinct pattern and texture. One figure holds a walking stick, while the other has their hand on a surface. The background is plain, emphasizing the characters and their attire.

artworks.title: Man seen from Behind with His Right Arm Extended
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-body illustrations of a person from the back, both in similar poses with slightly different linework. The person is standing with one arm extended out to the side. The facial features are not visible from this angle, but the hair is styled with curls and adorned with a feathered hat. The clothing consists of a long coat draped over the shoulders, a detailed shirt, and pants that gather at the knees. They also wear a sword on their left side. The background is plain and unadorned, with only faint lines and blemishes typical of an aged drawing.

artworks.title: Two Women in Profile
artworks.description: There are two full-body figures in a plain setting. The figure on the left appears to be a woman, standing with her body turned slightly to the side, looking to her right. She has distinct facial features and her hair is styled or covered, hidden partially by a hat adorned with a feather. Her attire is elaborate, featuring a long, layered gown with a voluminous, detailed overskirt and a fitted top. She seems to wear a hat that completes her outfit. The figure on the right, possibly a man, faces the woman, holding a cane in one hand and appears to be wearing a simpler, longer coat with a wide-brimmed hat. He also carries an object, clutched close to his chest with the other arm. The background is plain, with no discernible features or objects, and the ground beneath them is marked with a few simple lines suggesting a surface or terrain without any specific detail.

artworks.title: Lady in a Large Coat
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-length figures of a person, each in a slightly different pose. Both figures stand facing right with their heads turned slightly towards the viewer. They wear wide-brimmed hats and long flowing garments that reach the floor. The facial features are simple with minimal details. The background is plain with a light, textured appearance.

artworks.title: Gentleman in Large Mantle, Front View
artworks.description: The image displays two full-body illustrations of figures standing side by side. Both individuals are depicted in a theatrical or cavalier style, with their bodies angled slightly forward and to the side. The facial features of both figures are drawn with an exaggerated, comical style, and they have wavy hair peeking out from under wide-brimmed hats adorned with plumes. Their clothing consists of voluminous trousers that taper at the knee, accompanied by cloaks draped over their shoulders. Each figure wears a hat with feathers, and they carry a sword. The background of the image is plain.

artworks.title: Gentleman Viewed from the Side
artworks.description: The image depicts two full figures of a person shown from head to toe. Both figures are posed gracefully, turning slightly to the side, with one leg extended as though stepping sideways. The facial features are delicate, with a slight smile, and the hair is styled in soft curls, partially obscured by a large, decorative hat adorned with feathers. The clothing is elaborate, featuring a fur-trimmed cape draped over one shoulder and richly textured pants; the first figure's pants are striped while the second figure's pants are plain with bows at the knee. Each figure is wearing bows on their footwear and appears to be holding a thin, narrow object, likely a sword or rapier, which extends behind them. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the intricacy of the figures and their attire against the minimal backdrop.

artworks.title: Gentleman Viewed from the Front with Hand on Hip
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in similar standing positions with one leg slightly bent at the knee and hands on their hips. The individuals have matching facial features, shoulder-length hair, wide-brimmed hats with feathers, and are dressed in flowing robes with high collars, loose pants, and draped garments around their shoulders. One figure is holding what appears to be a sword. The background is plain with a light texture.

artworks.title: Gentleman in Large Mantle, Seen from Behind
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body sketches of figures seen from behind. The figure on the left wears a cloak, a hat with a feather, and holds a cane. Their hair is curly. The cloak splits at the back, revealing knee-length breeches tied at the knees. The figure on the right is similarly dressed, with slight differences in stance and cloak angle. The background is a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: Duel with Swords and Daggers
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two individuals engaging in a duel with swords. It shows two figures dressed in period garments, locked in combat positions. The figure on the left leans backward, extending their sword diagonally upwards while blocking the sword of the opposing figure on the right. The person on the right lunges forward with a deep bend at the waist, extending their sword arm. Both figures wear loose, pleated pants and fitted upper garments with intricate detailing. The drawing is rendered with precise line work, capturing the movement and tension of the duel.

artworks.title: Duel with Swords
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures engaged in a fencing match. The image depicts two individuals in a dynamic posture as they face each other with raised rapiers. Both figures are dressed in period clothing typical of the Renaissance or Baroque era, including puffed sleeves and breeches, with one figure sporting a feathered hat. Their feet are positioned firmly on the ground, and they appear to be mid-action. The drawing captures the focus and intensity of the duel, with detailed line work and shading giving depth and form to the figures and their garments. The scene is set on what appears to be a flat, slightly textured ground.

artworks.title: Peasant with Shovel on His Shoulder
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a figure standing on the right, holding a stick with a shovel on their shoulder. Buildings and small trees are faintly sketched on the horizon. The style is an etching with delicate lines and a minimal approach. The color palette is dominated by the paper's natural tone and dark ink lines define the figure and landscape. There is a sense of open space with a large negative space on the left side.

artworks.title: Peasant Attacked by Bees
artworks.description: The image features a man interacting with a swarm of flies. The man is dressed in a robe and hat, holding a staff and reaching out towards the flies. A dog stands beside him. In the background, there is a pastoral landscape with small figures and a structure near a tree. The etching uses cross-hatching and clean lines for texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink on beige paper.

artworks.title: Peasant with Sack
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 6.8 × 9 cm (2 11/16 × 3 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an individual standing in a landscape, facing slightly left. They are holding a staff in one hand and a bag in the other. The person has a long beard, wears a brimmed hat, and appears serious. They are dressed in flowing garments with a tunic, belted coat, and large boots. The background shows rugged terrain with trees. A goat stands to the left on a cliff. The illustration features detailed line work and a sky with cloud patterns.

artworks.title: Peasant Removing His Shoe
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.8 × 8.1 cm (2 5/16 × 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a serene scene with a horizon in the background, a hill with a small structure on top, a sketch of a donkey on the left, and a figure resting under a tree on the right. The artwork features detailed brushstrokes with fine linework creating texture and depth in the clothing and fur. The color palette is monochromatic with black and sepia tones on a beige background. Curved lines in the sky hint at clouds or wind.

artworks.title: Peasant Defecating
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 6.3 × 8.1 cm (2 1/2 × 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crouching figure near a tree with a goat grazing in the background. The image shows a cloaked and hooded figure squatting in the left foreground, their form defined by strong contour lines and subtle shading. The figure is nestled against a large, textured tree that extends out of the scene at the top edge. In the distance to the right, a goat with an exaggeratedly long coat bends down to graze on the ground. Sparse foliage and a single rope fence provide sparse environmental details. The use of fine line work gives the drawing a delicate and sketchy quality, emphasizing both figures and natural elements.

artworks.title: Shepherd Playing Flute
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 5.6 × 7.9 cm (2 3/16 × 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image is viewed from a slightly elevated angle, showing figures, landscape, horizon, sky, structures, lines, texture, color palette, shepherd with a staff playing an instrument, dog, grazing goats, and a tree.

artworks.title: Dancers with Flute and Tambourine
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in fantastical costumes playing instruments. The image portrays two figures wearing ornate, patterned clothing. One figure holds a small drum or tambourine-like instrument and poses with one leg lifted, while the other figure appears to be playing a wind instrument similar to a flute or pipe. Both figures display energetic gestures. The background is minimal, emphasizing the figures. The costumes and lines contribute to the lively feel of the scene.

artworks.title: Dancers with Lute
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two abstract, costumed figures facing each other. The image displays two exaggerated, comical figures. On the left, a figure with a bulbous, distorted face and an elaborate headpiece is dressed in layered robes. The figure seems to be lifting one foot. On the right, another figure, also with an exaggerated face and a comical nose, stands holding a lute or similar stringed instrument. This figure’s clothing is similarly voluminous and layered. The style is reminiscent of a satirical or humorous depiction, using exaggerated features and attire.

artworks.title: Two Pantaloons Dancing
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.4 × 8 cm (2 1/8 × 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in dynamic poses. The figures are rendered in a style that suggests caricature or fantasy, with unusual physical characteristics and exaggerated movements. They are depicted symmetrically on either side of the image, with elongated bodies and wearing fitted garments with pointed elements. One figure is shown mid-stride with one leg lifted and arms postured, while the other mirrors this stance. The background is simple, and strong contour lines outline the figures against the plain background.

artworks.title: Two Pantaloons Dancing
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two humanoid figures facing each other. The figures have exaggerated facial features and are adorned with horned hats. Both characters appear to be in motion. The figure on the left is mid-stride with one leg lifted, while the figure on the right is standing with a slightly forward-leaning pose, their arm resting on their hip. The drawing uses fine lines and minimal shading, with a plain background.

artworks.title: Almshouse
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.6 × 8.1 cm (2 3/16 × 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a street scene with a perspective view focusing on a large building with a series of arches and a sloped roof. The point of view is slightly elevated, allowing us to see multiple figures scattered across the open space leading up to the building. The horizon is high in the composition, creating a sense of depth and space. There are trees lined up in the distance behind the building. The artwork is rendered with fine lines, suggesting a technique consistent with an engraving or etching. The color palette is monochrome, composed of black lines on a tan background. Closest to us, a figure in a large hat gestures towards the scene, while other people and animals, including a small dog, are positioned around the square in various postures.

artworks.title: Tavern
artworks.description: The image depicts a ground-level view of an area with architectural structures and people engaged in activities. On the left, there is a large figure with a stick, a tree with detailed leaves, and a group of individuals around a wooden table. To the right, there is a large building with stairs and an arched doorway. Various figures are depicted on the steps adding to the scene's sense of daily life. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of brown, creating a cohesive and visually striking image.
